events.title: 애스턴 빌라 seal their first league title for 71 years despite losing their final game of the season 2–0 to 아스널 as 입스위치 타운 lose 2–1 to 미들즈브러, their third League defeat in four matches. 노리치 시티 are relegated after a 3–2 home defeat to second-bottom 레스터 시티. Joining 웨스트햄 유나이티드 in promotion to the First Division are 노츠 카운티 after 55 years away, and 스완지 시티 for the first time in their history.
Zico scores the only goal as Brazil beat England 1–0 at Wembley.
